bio.summary: Brockett is seeking another term as Boulder mayor, a role he has held since 2021. His campaign points to housing, homelessness, climate resilience and city finances.
bio.public_office: Boulder mayor since 2021; city councilmember since 2015; previously Boulder Planning Board

statements.text: Brockett is generally aligned with the council’s progressive majority, particularly on housing. During his tenure, the council loosened restrictions on accessory dwelling units, made it easier to build duplexes and triplexes, allowed more housing near downtown and along transit corridors, eliminated minimum parking requirements and repealed occupancy limits. Brockett wants to continue expanding “missing middle” housing and creating more neighborhoods where residents can meet their daily needs without driving.
statements.speaker: Boulder Reporting Lab reporter
